LESSON: PICTURE READING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.1: Picture Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Picture Reading, part of Reading in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we use water at home?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. name activities that involve uses of water,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Picture Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

Core competencies:

• Learning to learn: The learner persists and pursues in observing pictures to acquire new information about uses of water.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: The learner correctly interprets illustrations related to uses of water.

• Responsibility: The learner demonstrates self-drive while role playing uses of water at home.
